Author: Pankaj Purohit Bench: Pankaj Purohit  Office Notes,

with Signatures  WPCRL No.715 of 2025  Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Amit Kapri, learned counsel for the petitioner.

2. Mr. Bhaskar Chandra Joshi, learned A.G.A. for State of Uttarakhand/ respondent Nos.1 and 2.
3.

By means of this criminal writ petition, petitioner has put to challenge the FIR No.0155 of 2025 dated 29.06.2025, for the offence punishable under Section 420 IPC, registered with P.S. Mukhani,
District Nainital.

4. After arguing a while, learned counsel for the petitioner has limited his argument to the extent that the Investigating Agency should comply with the guidelines given in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and Another reported in (2014) 8 SCC 5.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and Another reported in (2014) 8 SCC 5
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Since the offences under Section 420 IPC, carry a punishment maximum to seven years,
therefore, before resorting to any arrest a prior notice under Section 35(3) of the B.N.S.S., 2023 (under Section 41A of Cr.P.C.) is necessary to be issued to the petitioner.

Hence, it is provided that before taking any coercive measures against the petitioner, Investigating Officer shall abide by procedure given under Section 35(3) of the BNSS Act, 2023 (under Section 41A of Cr.P.C.).
It is also directed that the petitioner shall cooperate with the investigation.
6. Accordingly, the criminal writ petition stands disposed of.
7. Pending application, if any, also stands disposed of.
